value.rationale: The precise quantity—the remaining feeding time once the first scenter forms—is the minimal nontrivial instance where recruitment helps arrival but the same fed bee impedes service. A complete and unexpected disconnected optimizer classification (finite rate, zero rate, finite rate), plus exact universal appearance threshold v_c and algebraic examples, supplies a natural benchmark and a boundary to large-colony intermediate-optimum heuristics. It is not an arbitrary statistic, minor parameter tuning, or a claim that the full biology behaves the same.
